criteria.reason: Correctly says communes can restrict, but omits cantonal competence; no contradiction of key facts.
Only vague reference to cantonal approval; never says details depend on cantonal law or communal regulations; no invented articles.
Gives six numbered, actionable local steps (petition, assembly, escalation), though some are tangential.
Silent on national initiative; no advocacy or voting recommendation.

summary: Affirms communal power to restrict fireworks with vague legal framing; gives generic but actionable civic steps; omits cantonal competence and the national initiative.
